rules-third-party.title: Third parties and visitors

cases.situation: Your unlicensed friend wants to tell a relative in Brazil about a birthday party.
cases.why: Personal, non-commercial third-party traffic is allowed.

cases.situation: A neighbour wants you to pass an order to their supplier.
A foreign station breaks into your friend's conversation.

options: One that objected to the ITU
One that isn't in the IARU
cases.answer: One that objected to the ITU
cases.why: A filed objection with the ITU precludes contact.

rules-third-party.success: Personal and non-commercial, with anyone, unless their country objects.
